project_info.theme: Techcombank cardholder privilege at Tam Son Annual Sale
project_info.color_palette: Deep blue, golden sunrise, white, champagne beige, bronze

main_subject.detail: A premium lifestyle poster for a luxury retail promotion. The logos 'TAM SON' and 'TECHCOMBANK' appear at the top. Large headline text reads 'Giam gia den 10% tai Tam Son Annual Sale'. The supporting line says 'Dac quyen danh rieng cho chu the Techcombank Visa Infinite va Visa Signature'. In the center stands a dramatic modern hotel tower lit by warm sunrise glow, with a location pin label reading 'Pullman Sai Gon Centre'. Bottom-right badge says 'Dinh hinh PHONG CACH SONG'. Bottom-left shows the brand line 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'. The legal copy states the offer applies from '16 - 17/07/2026' when paying by physical card or Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Google Pay, Garmin Pay.
main_subject.style: Luxury-travel lifestyle poster with architectural hero shot, radiant sunrise haze, and premium cardholder-offer aesthetics
